message.content: In the recorded sessions, Turalyon did not specifically address feedback from residents regarding the construction noise after Illidan Stormrage raised his concerns. Instead, Turalyon mentioned a few suggestions for managing noise levels during construction, including limiting noisy activities during key hours, notifying residents in advance, and using temporary barriers or quieter tools. He also proposed posting updates in the chat or placing notices at the entrance of the garden. Malfurion Stormrage added that residents could be notified a day in advance about any particularly loud work, which would help them plan around it. Additionally, Grom Hellscream suggested incorporating sound-absorbing materials for benches or play areas and planting taller shrubs or trees to act as a natural barrier. These suggestions were all part of the ongoing discussions about how to minimize noise during the garden renovation. There was no mention of feedback from residents after Illidan Stormrage's complaint, so it appears Turalyon focused on providing solutions rather than discussing specific resident feedback.
